candidates.location_hint: the target element that the skip-to-content link jumps to
candidates.why: Generic divs are not focusable by default, so keyboard users may not actually move focus to this location without additional attributes.

candidates.location_hint: the main content area and the sidebar navigation relative to each other in the markup
candidates.why: CSS flex order visually places the sidebar first, but the DOM structure puts main before aside, which will cause the keyboard tab sequence to jump backward visually.

candidates.location_hint: the floating action button positioned at the bottom right of the viewport
candidates.why: Explicitly assigning a positive tab index forces this control into an unnatural position in the keyboard sequence, breaking the expected reading order.

candidates.location_hint: the focus outline on the floating action button
candidates.why: The dark blue outline color against the button's blue background may have insufficient contrast to be clearly visible to keyboard users.

candidates.location_hint: the heading text inside the sidebar navigation landmark
candidates.why: Using a level-two heading inside a sidebar alongside a page-level heading might disrupt the document outline; worth verifying if it should be scoped or use an aria-level attribute.
